title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E5 — Black Day at Bad Rock
The A-Team helps a small-town sheriff fend off a vengeful motorcycle gang. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E6 — The Rabbit Who Ate Las Vegas
The kidnapping of a gambler leads to a mobster (Charles Cioffi) and then to a $100,000 price on Hannibal's head.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E7 — The Out-of-Towners
The team aids Manhattan shopkeepers victimized by mobsters extorting protection money; guest Yaphet Kotto.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E8 — Holiday in the Hills
Fanatical mountain men attack after the team crash-lands deep in the Appalachians; guests Edward Winter, Bill McKinney.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E8 — Alice in Disco Land
In a disco, Banner learns a dancer (Donna Wilkes) is being exploited.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E7 — Another Path
A Chinese philosopher's nerve-control techniques may help Banner; guest Mako.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E14 — Like a Brother
Banner gets caught between a dope dealer and a crusading preacher; guests Carl Anderson, Ernie Hudson.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E13 — A Solitary Place
A beautiful fugitive (Kathryn Leigh Scott) interrupts Banner's wilderness retreat.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S2 E1 — Married
Banner finds love with a psychiatrist (Mariette Hartley) with a problem of her own.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S3 E10 — Lost Knight
A boy (Jason Bateman) adopts KITT after a collision leaves Michael dazed and the supercar without its memory.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S3 E11 — Knight of the Chameleon
Michael searches for an elusive master of disguises who is planning to steal sophisticated government weapons.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E16 — Syndrome
Gage diagnoses tonsillitis for DeSoto, who claims to have had his tonsils removed; McCall is reunited with an old love (Robert Alda).

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E17 — Honest
Gage's and DeSoto's stands on honesty are put to the test when people who withhold vital information experience different consequences.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E18 — Seance
A woman believes her dead sister is the cause of accidents in her home; a man is trapped underwater in his car with the doors jammed.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E19 — Boot
Station 51's mascot, Boot, won't eat; accidents befall a woman attempting to cook a meal; a man nearly dies from an aspirin overdose.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E20 — Rip-Off
The paramedics conduct several rescues under a shadow of guilt after being accused of stealing from a patient; guest Jo Anne Worley.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E21 — Audit
DeSoto must decide whether to amputate the leg of a trapped construction worker (James McEachin); nervous Gage faces an IRS tax audit.
